description: This file defines the ComplexData class, representing a transient object extending Obs, used to encapsulate complex data (such as InputStreams or byte arrays) associated with observations in the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for data, title, MIME type, and length, along with corresponding getters, setters, and constructors.

classes.name: ComplexData
classes.description: A transient object for handling complex observation data, not persisted in the database. It can store various data formats like InputStream or byte arrays, and includes metadata such as title, MIME type, and data length.

methods.name: ComplexData
methods.description: Constructs a new ComplexData instance with a specified title and data object.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title or description of this ComplexData.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title or description for this ComplexData.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data object, which could be an InputStream, byte array, or other object.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data object for this ComplexData instance.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type associated with the data.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type for the data.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the data.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the data.
